Fertility & Gynecology · NeoSculpt6

Dr. Payal Mahapatra

Fertility Specialist & Gynecologist

MBBS · DGO, Obstetrics and Gynecology · DNB, Diplomate of National Board · Fellowship in Reproductive Medicine

Dr. Payal Mahapatra is a fertility specialist and gynecologist, and the founder of Neo Fertility Clinic, part of Neo Group. She trained in obstetrics and gynecology before completing a Fellowship in Reproductive Medicine, and is a member of ISAR and FOGSI.

Contact NeoSculpt6

Background

From Gynecology Into Reproductive Medicine

Dr. Payal Mahapatra qualified in medicine in 2005 and specialised in obstetrics and gynecology before moving into reproductive medicine. Her Fellowship in Reproductive Medicine, completed at IIRRH in 2017, is dedicated training in ovarian stimulation protocols, assisted reproduction, embryology liaison and the management of failed cycles.

She founded Neo Fertility Clinic to run fertility treatment and obstetric care as one continuous service, so the doctor who manages the treatment also manages the pregnancy, including high-risk pregnancies.

Clinical Focus

Areas of Expertise

  • Assisted reproduction

    IVF, ICSI, IUI, ovulation induction, frozen embryo transfer, donor gamete programmes.

  • Fertility preservation

    Egg freezing before cancer treatment, before ovarian surgery, and for elective deferral of pregnancy.

  • Reproductive endocrinology

    PCOS and PMOS, PCOD, thyroid and prolactin disorders, insulin resistance, hyperandrogenism.

  • Reproductive surgery

    Hysteroscopy for polyps, submucous fibroids, adhesions and septum. Laparoscopy for endometriosis, adhesions, ovarian cysts and tubal disease.

  • Recurrent pregnancy loss

    Investigation and management of repeated miscarriage and repeated implantation failure.

  • High-risk obstetrics

    Gestational diabetes, hypertensive disorders, IVF pregnancies, previous caesarean, twins.

Personalised Assessment

Begin With a Clear Consultation

  1. 01

    Begin With Your Concern

    Tell the doctor what you would like to change and what you have already tried. Your history and goals shape everything that follows.

  2. 02

    Assess Suitability

    The doctor examines the area and reviews your health and history to see which options may suit you, and which may not.

  3. 03

    Discuss the Right Options

    You hear what each option involves, including alternatives, limitations, recovery and cost, before anything is planned.

  4. 04

    Move Forward With Clarity

    If you decide to go ahead, your plan, preparation and aftercare are explained so you know what to expect at each step.
